notes: Fair puzzle. Each wrong Greek option fails exactly one constraint, so it comes down to careful reading of reviews.
Mina's diet is never named; it is inferred from 'side salads and fries' plus 'not fish either'. Clear enough with the Driftwood and Salt Marsh reviews as contrast, but it is the subtlest clue.
Roxy's dairy issue is implied (water taxi + 'milkshake incident'). Reads as an intolerance, which fits the 1-star penalty.

Minor ambiguity: Tidewater's loudness is framed as 'Go on a Friday...'. The chat never says tonight is Friday. A cautious player might wonder whether the room is loud on other nights. Consider making the noise not tied to a specific night.
Seawall loses only one star (dairy intolerance), so it is a 2-star safe fallback; Copper Buoy, Cormorant and Breakwater are also 2-star. Only Salt Marsh and Driftwood are deal-breakers.
